bankNames.title: Bank name searches
bankNames.description: Bank names to look up, one per line ("JPMorgan Chase", "First National"). Each returns matching FDIC-insured institutions with financials.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Matches per name search
maxResultsPerQuery.description: How many matching banks to return per name search.

states.title: Browse states
states.description: Two-letter state codes to list banks for, one per line ("CA", "TX"). Returns each state's banks sorted largest-first by assets.

maxPerState.title: Banks per state
maxPerState.description: How many banks to return per state (largest first).

activeOnly.title: Active banks only
activeOnly.description: Only currently operating banks. Turn off to include closed and merged institutions.

minAssetsMillions.title: Minimum assets ($ millions)
minAssetsMillions.description: Only banks with at least this many millions in total assets. 0 = no minimum.

includeBranches.title: Include branch locations
includeBranches.description: For every matched bank, also emit one row per branch with street address, city, county and service type.

maxBranchesPerBank.title: Branches per bank
maxBranchesPerBank.description: Cap on branch rows per bank (large banks have thousands).

failuresSinceYear.title: Bank failures since year
failuresSinceYear.description: Also list every US bank failure from this year on, with assets, deposits and estimated loss at failure. 0 = off.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
